restart_checks.json_state_sha256_basis: exact JSON roundtrip; source and output receipts sealed separately

execution: Same resized account and cost/funding/capacity mechanics as prior56cases; only optional source-default actual-inventory forecast buffer is added in a versioned engine. All controls use this engine with buffer disabled; they must reproduce prior screen ledgers and metrics.
changes_vs_previous: Source default annual risk16percent and cap20 are mathematical references, not full source performance reproduction. Crypto uses365 instead of business days, common robust35dayvol/floor instead of upstream current mixedvol, top10liquid pool instead of private source instruments, fixed2024scale instead of future-backfilled estimates, common0.8gross/no leverage/8percent stop/15percent hardhalt. Current broad40pool has survivorship selection bias and is not point-in-time membership.
